europe_now.title: Baltic Sea Maritime Security Incident
europe_now.summary: Finland reported that the conflict is spilling over following a drone strike on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland. A Russian helicopter was also suspected of violating Finnish airspace during the regional security escalation.
